title: Gemini 4 Release Date: 'Soon' Has Already Burned Four Bets
description: Google says Gemini 4 is in post-training and due well before year-end, bettors say October, the leaked scores and $2.25 price have no source, and Antigravity is still the catch
body:
## 3-Line TL;DR

- Google has no Gemini 4 date, only "much earlier" than the end of 2026, and bettors put a public release by October 31 at 79%
- The leaked scores and the $2.25 / $11.25 price have no named source, so treat them as rumor until Google posts a model page
- Do not pause a working Claude Code or Codex setup for it, because Google is testing Gemini 4 inside Antigravity first

## "Much earlier than year-end" still leaves three months

- Google announced the Gemini 4 pre-training run on July 22, calling it its "most ambitious" yet ([Alphabet Q2 remarks](https://blog.google/company-news/inside-google/message-ceo/alphabet-earnings-q2-2026/))
- On September 24, DeepMind chief Koray Kavukcuoglu said the model is in post-training ([9to5Google](https://9to5google.com/2026/09/24/google-says-gemini-4-release-is-coming-as-soon-as-possible/), from [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/articles/google-nears-release-flagship-gemini-4-ai-model))
- He wants to release an early post-training version "as soon as possible" and "much earlier" than the end of the year
- Seen from September 24, "much earlier than December 31" covers about three months
- Post-training includes safety testing, guardrails and internal testing with Gemini 4 powering Antigravity
- No tier name, benchmark, context size or price came with it
- The wait feels long because Gemini 3.5 Pro was teased in the summer and never shipped, per the same 9to5Google report

## Bettors have already lost four deadlines

![Polymarket odds for a public Gemini 4 release: four expired deadlines, then 2.25% by Sep 30, 79% by Oct 31, 94.5% by Nov 30](/images/posts/ai/gemini-4-release-odds.webp)

*Source: [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/gemini-4pt0-released-by-june-30-2026) — Gemini 4.0 released by...?, prices checked September 28, 2026 08:15 UTC — chart by HSL*

- The market pays out only on a public release, not a closed beta or private access
- The June 30, July 31, August 31 and September 15 deadlines all resolved "No"
- The skeptics have been paid four times on this one market
- September 30 now trades at 2.25%, October 31 at 79% and November 30 at 94.5%
- These are bettors' prices, not a Google date, but they are the only dated numbers anyone has
- My read is October or November, with a "preview" label very likely attached

## The leak wore a name Google had already used

- The leak says a model tested on Arena on September 17 was an early Gemini 4 Pro ([TechBriefly](https://techbriefly.com/2026/09/21/gemini-4-pro-benchmarks-beat-gpt-6-astra-claude/), [BigGo](https://finance.biggo.com/news/66df2f89-c067-43d7-b888-94deb071f472))
- It appeared under the name "gemini-3.8-flash"
- Google had released a real Gemini 3.8 Flash on September 2, 15 days earlier ([Google](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/3-8-flash-and-3-8-flash-cyber/))
- The rumored scores are 88% on DeepSWE v1.1, 95.3% on Terminal-bench 2.1 and 86.8% on OSWorld-2.0
- The numbers come with one decimal place and zero links
- Neither report names a leaker or links a screenshot, and Google has confirmed none of it
- The same reports claim a 10M-token input limit and cross-session memory, also unconfirmed

## The rumored price lands between Flash and Opus

![Output price per 1M tokens: Gemini 3.8 Flash $3.75 then $7.50, rumored Gemini 4 Pro $11.25, Opus 5.5 $20, Astra $50](/images/posts/ai/gemini-4-price-context.webp)

*Sources: [Google](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/3-8-flash-and-3-8-flash-cyber/), [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/claude-opus-5-5), [OpenAI](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing) standard rates checked September 28, 2026; Gemini 4 price from [TechBriefly](https://techbriefly.com/2026/09/21/gemini-4-pro-benchmarks-beat-gpt-6-astra-claude/), unconfirmed — chart by HSL*

| Model | Input per 1M | Output per 1M | Status |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | :--- |
| Gemini 3.8 Flash | $0.75 | $3.75 | Official intro price to Dec 31, 2026 |
| Gemini 3.8 Flash | $1.50 | $7.50 | Official from Jan 1, 2027 |
| Gemini 4 Pro | $2.25 | $11.25 | Rumor |
| Claude Opus 5.5 | $4 | $20 | Official |
| GPT-6 Astra | $10 | $50 | Official, short context |

- If the rumor holds, Gemini 4 Pro lists 44% below Opus 5.5 and 77.5% below Astra per token
- It would also cost 1.5 times Google's own Flash after the Flash discount ends
- Google's Flash launch post already warns the model "might use more tokens" to maximize performance
- The cheap model politely announces it will eat more
- A per-token price says little until you divide the bill by finished tasks, as the [Astra vs Opus 5.5 same-prompt test](/en/posts/gpt-6-sol-luna-opus-5-5-cost-per-success/) showed

## A better model does not fix Antigravity

- In my use, Antigravity is far less usable than Claude Code or Codex
- That is my impression of the tool, not a measured comparison
- Google says Antigravity has more than 2.4 million weekly active users ([Alphabet Q2 remarks](https://blog.google/company-news/inside-google/message-ceo/alphabet-earnings-q2-2026/))
- Since May, Gemini Flash and Pro draw down one shared limit at API prices ([Antigravity](https://antigravity.google/blog/changes-to-antigravity-plans))
- A pricier flagship would likely drain that shared limit faster than Flash
- When the new limits landed, some users hit them within an hour of work ([9to5Google](https://9to5google.com/2026/05/21/google-has-tripled-gemini-usage-limits-for-antigravity-twice/))
- Google tripled the limits twice in one week, and users still said they were below the old levels
- Gemini 4 powering Antigravity internally means the model may reach that tool first

| Your setup | What I would do |
| :--- | :--- |
| Happy with Claude Code or Codex | Keep working, and test Gemini 4 through the API once Google posts a model page |
| Already paying for Google AI Pro or Ultra | Try it in Antigravity on day one, but watch how fast the shared limit drains |
| Choosing by price | Wait for the official price, then compare cost per finished task |
| Thinking of subscribing now to be ready | Wait, because no tier, price or limit is confirmed |

## Q&A (Field Notes)

- **Q. Is Gemini 4 already on Arena?**
  - Unconfirmed, and the entry blamed for it used the name of a model Google had already released
- **Q. Will Gemini 4 be cheaper than Opus 5.5?**
  - Per token it would be 44% cheaper if the rumor holds, but the price is unsourced and cost per task is a separate question
- **Q. What can I use from Google right now?**
  - Gemini 3.8 Flash is out at $0.75 / $3.75 per 1M tokens until December 31, then $1.50 / $7.50
- **Q. Should I switch to Antigravity to be ready for Gemini 4?**
  - Not before it launches, since the model, price and limits are all still unannounced
